name: Quick chat
description:
# Summary

The user requested a compact sidebar feature to save horizontal space in the chat application. I implemented this feature across three Vue components (ChatView, ChatSidebar, and ChatSidebarNode) by adding a `compactSidebar` boolean state and conditional rendering based on the `isCompact` prop. In compact mode, the sidebar reduces from 256px to 80px width, displaying only icons and message counts with tooltips instead of full text descriptions and controls. A toggle button in the sidebar footer allows users to switch between normal and compact modes seamlessly. The implementation maintains full functionality while optimizing screen real estate for better space utilization.
